title: Fixed Round Wrap and Three Rotary Lever Horn
description: One newly authored whole static rotary-horn-style exterior. A continuous near-circular hollow main tube surrounds three short broad rotor drum housings and flows into a back-swept expanding open side bell. Each drum has its own raised cover, fixed spindle and crank, complete short link rod, separate lever paddle and upper return slide. A common supported lever bearing and three rooted branch stays connect the complete assembly. A higher swept inlet ends in a real open shallow cup. All numeric geometry is new, with no imported instrument meshes. The surrounding round wrap and low rotary-linkage bank are not the old long valveless U bugle lengthened or an inline three-piston trumpet scaled or recoloured. Four opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and horizontal-envelope-centred datum on three finite rotor-cap lower faces. One whole prop, zero scenes. Generic fixed illustrative exterior only: the drum housings are solid, internal acoustic routing and airtightness are not modeled; no sound, tuning, playability, rotor motion, linkage operation, exact historical design, fit, manufacture or safety claim. No animation, rigging, interaction, player or stand.
